Questions

Good to know

Are the prices in USD?

Yes. All prices are in US dollars. The Ranger is listed at US$35,000 and is negotiable. Message us for the Prado price.

Can I view a vehicle before buying?

Yes. Message us the vehicle you like and we will arrange a viewing.

Do the vehicles have service history?

The Prado comes with full service history. Ask us about any vehicle and we will share what we have.

What hours can I reach you?

Our line is open 24 hours. We reply as soon as we can.

Can you send more photos?

Of course. Ask on WhatsApp and we will send more.
